1. "id": the result of 467 multiplied by 7 (as a number, not a string)
2. "name": the word "velvet" in ALL UPPERCASE letters
3. "tags": exactly these 4 strings in ALPHABETICAL order: "humus", "brick", "ember", "alpha"
